attchmntText: ORTIN GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Ortin Global Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter ended 30.09.2026. The company reported a net loss of 26.86 lakhs for the quarter, compared to a loss of 50.25 lakhs in the corresponding period of the previous year. For the half-year ended 30.09.2026, the net loss was 60.65 lakhs. The Board noted the resignation of M/s. Mathesh & Ramana as Statutory Auditors, effective 12th November, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of M/s. S. D. Mehta and Co. as the new Statutory Auditors to fill the casual vacancy. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval at a general meeting. The new auditors will hold office until the conclusion of the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

attchmntText: ORTIN GLOBAL LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ortin Global Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30.09.2026. The company reported a net loss of 26.86 lakhs for the quarter, compared to a loss of 50.25 lakhs in the same period last year. Year-to-date loss stands at 60.65 lakhs against 67.79 lakhs previously. The Board noted the resignation of M/s. Mathesh & Ramana as statutory auditors effective 12th November 2026. M/s. S. D. Mehta and Co. was appointed to fill the casual vacancy. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval at a general meeting. The new auditors will hold office until the conclusion of the ensuing Annual General Meeting.
